ring.units: radii are fractions of the half-size (800 px)
ring.angle_convention: 0 deg = 3 o'clock, counter-clockwise on screen; latches and long ticks share these angles (12-fold symmetric, step 30 deg)

clamp.anchor_note: anchor = point on the ring's outer rim at 3 o'clock; the clamp is authored at the ring's scale, so place it with anchor_px on ring pixel (1576, 800) and scale both by the same factor

style: LAST DOCK logo metal: cream #FFF4E0 -> gold #F0A030 -> copper, Standard view transform (as menu_logo), glow #F0A030 at 30 % (sigma 9/22 px)
